CREATE TABLE range_schema_rule_log (result boolean); CREATE RULE range_schema_rule AS ON INSERT TO range_schema_rule_input DO ALSO INSERT INTO range_schema_rule_log VALUES (nextval('range_schema_seq') BETWEEN SYMMETRIC NULL::bigint AND 100); CREATE TABLE range_schema_trigger_input (id integer); CREATE FUNCTION range_schema_trigger_function() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END $$; CREATE TRIGGER range_schema_trigger BEFORE INSERT ON range_schema_trigger_input FOR EACH ROW WHEN (nextval('range_schema_seq') BETWEEN SYMMETRIC NULL::bigint AND 100) EXECUTE FUNCTION range_schema_trigger_function(); CREATE TABLE range_schema_guard_input(id integer); CREATE RULE range_schema_guard_rule AS ON INSERT TO range_schema_guard_input WHERE (nextval('range_schema_seq') BETWEEN SYMMETRIC NULL::bigint AND 100) DO ALSO INSERT INTO range_schema_rule_log VALUES (true); CREATE TABLE range_schema_generated(id integer, result boolean GENERATED ALWAYS AS (id BETWEEN SYMMETRIC 3 AND 1) STORED); CREATE INDEX range_schema_key ON range_schema_generated ((id BETWEEN SYMMETRIC 3 AND 1)); CREATE INDEX range_schema_partial ON range_schema_generated(id) WHERE id BETWEEN SYMMETRIC 3 AND 1; CREATE TABLE range_schema_partitioned(id integer) PARTITION BY LIST ((id BETWEEN SYMMETRIC 1 AND 3)); CREATE TABLE range_schema_true PARTITION OF range_schema_partitioned FOR VALUES IN (true); CREATE TABLE range_schema_false PARTITION OF range_schema_partitioned FOR VALUES IN (false); CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER range_schema_fdw; CREATE SERVER range_schema_server FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER range_schema_fdw; CREATE FOREIGN TABLE range_schema_foreign(id integer CHECK (id BETWEEN SYMMETRIC 3 AND 1), result boolean DEFAULT (nextval('range_schema_seq') BETWEEN SYMMETRIC NULL::bigint AND 100)) SERVER range_schema_server
